target: Hito natural del Paso de las Lajas.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Gran saliente rocosa que funciona como refugio natural del viento; debe ser inmediatamente legible como abrigo de viaje sin convertirse en cueva.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide landscape of Piedra de Resguardo. A massive natural overhanging slab creates a dry wind-shadow beside the narrow regional route. Wind-driven dust and bent scrub outside contrast with calmer ground beneath the overhang. The shelter is shallow and open, with daylight visible around it; travelers could pause there but no built camp is required. Tilted layered geology ties it to the Hoshai–Korven transition.
negative_constraints: No cave entrance or deep cavern

No magic, crystals or dramatic fantasy monolith
No characters or creatures as focal subject
